issues.description: Postcondition of resolve() silently changed; req.prepared and needs_more_preparation invariants now unestablished on exit
issues.detail: The resolver previously guaranteed, on return, that every requirement satisfied prepared=True and needs_more_preparation=False. The patch deletes that loop without restating the postcondition or proving each caller now re-establishes it. Every caller of resolve() is now responsible for an invariant that used to be the resolver's. State the new postcondition explicitly or reinstate it.

issues.description: Missing caller: --dry-run install path is not shown to call prepare_linked_requirements_more, yet the news entry claims dry-run avoids downloads
issues.detail: The install command adds prepare_linked_requirements_more only on the non-dry-run branch (after the early SUCCESS return). Good for the stated goal, but the diff does not exhibit the dry-run branch, so I cannot verify that req.download_info and metadata-only dist suffice for --report output downstream. The author must state the precondition that report-emission requires and prove it holds without further preparation. TESTED-NOT-PROVED.

issues.description: set_dist/get_dist precedence rule is unstated; the elif chain encodes a priority order with no documented invariant
issues.detail: get_dist now prefers self._distribution over metadata_directory over local_file_path. No comment explains why a cached metadata-only distribution must take precedence over a later-materialized metadata_directory, nor what happens if both are set after full preparation completes. A subsequent prepare could leave a stale metadata-only dist shadowing the real one. State the invariant or clear _distribution on full prepare.

issues.description: download_info is assigned via direct_url_from_link(req.link, req.source_dir) when source_dir may be None in metadata-only mode
issues.detail: At the point _fetch_metadata_only succeeds, nothing has been unpacked; req.source_dir is typically unset. direct_url_from_link's contract with a None source_dir is not demonstrated in the diff. If it raises or produces a malformed DirectUrl, pip lock / --report output is silently corrupted. Author must state the precondition on source_dir and prove it.

issues.description: Three command modules now duplicate the same prepare_linked_requirements_more call site; the abstraction has leaked
issues.detail: download.py, install.py, and wheel.py each independently invoke prepare_linked_requirements_more after resolve(). The resolver used to own this. Three copies of a postcondition-restoration step is exactly the unstructured smuggling of control flow that produces the next bug. A single helper, or restoring it to the resolver with a dry-run flag, would be more honest.

issues.description: No test evidence in the diff; correctness rests on the claim that existing tests pass
issues.detail: The diff contains no new test exercising the dry-run-no-download property, no test that pip lock emits download_info from metadata-only paths, and no test for the new set_dist/get_dist precedence. Testing shows the presence of bugs, not their absence; but the absence of any test for the load-bearing new behaviour is itself a defect. TESTED-NOT-PROVED.

review.summary: UNREASONED in places, REFUSED as written. The patch achieves a desirable behaviour — no full-wheel download under --dry-run when PEP 658 metadata exists — but it does so by deleting a postcondition from the resolver and scattering its restoration across three command modules without stating the new contract. The set_dist/get_dist precedence and the download_info=direct_url_from_link(req.link, req.source_dir) assignment both rest on preconditions the author has not articulated. The news entry promises a property the diff does not prove. Restore or restate the invariants, then I will reconsider.
